verdict.rationale: A hardware security-key vendor could plausibly ship a versioned management API or SDK, so this axis applies. The evidence shows none: the probe states Titan ships no vendor CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface, and fleet management runs through the separate Google Workspace Admin console. Nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. Its mention of FIDO CTAP1 support describes standards compatibility, not a versioned vendor API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
